'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Twelve-Day War]]
***[[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War|Airstrikes during the Twelve-Day War]]
****[[2025 United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites|United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites]]
*****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[United States Air Force|U.S. Air Force]] has conducted strikes on several [[nuclear facilities in Iran|nuclear facilities]] in [[Iran]], including [[Natanz Nuclear Facility]] and [[Fordow Uranium Enrichment Plant]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/trump-announces-that-us-has-completed-successful-attack-on-three-iran-nuke-sites/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*****The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] says no increase in off-site radiation levels was detected at the three targeted nuclear sites. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/22/us-bombs-irans-nuclear-sites-what-we-know-so-far (Al Jazeera)]
*****A report by ''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' finds that [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] on the [[United States Senate Select Committee on Intelligence|Senate]] and [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House]] Intelligence panels were not given advance notice of the attack, while [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] were given advance notice. [https://www.axios.com/2025/06/22/democrats-trump-iran-nuclear-facilities (''Axios'')]
*****The [[Parliament of Iran]] votes for the closure of the [[Strait of Hormuz]] in response to the U.S. attacks. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2025/jun/22/oil-prices-expected-to-rise-after-us-attack-on-iran (''The Guardian'')]
*****Iran launches over 40 [[ballistic missile]]s at Israel, injuring at least 23 people and destroying apartments and homes. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-iran-strikes-tel-aviv-nuclear-309953597c37f73441974a3c15001d80 (AP)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
****[[Israel]]i forces in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] recover the bodies of three hostages who were abducted by the [[Palestinian militant]] group [[Hamas]] during the [[October 7 attacks]]. Fifty hostages remain in Gaza, of which 20 are thought to remain alive. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-recover-bodies-three-hostages-gaza-2025-06-22/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] kill at least 51 people and injure 104 others in southern [[Khan Younis]], central Gaza, and northern [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/22/live-us-joins-israels-attacks-on-iran-bombs-three-nuclear-sites?update=3792152 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Mar Elias Church attack]]
***At least 23 people are killed, including the perpetrator, and 63 others are injured when at least one alleged [[Islamic State]] [[Suicide attack|suicide attacker]] opens fire and detonates an explosive device inside the Mar Elias Church in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/suicide-bomber-strikes-syrian-church-near-damascus-during-mass/ (CTV News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/06/22/syria-church-attack-damascus-mass/55765d8a-4f88-11f0-baaa-ba1025f321a8_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and more than 70 others are injured after a security barrier collapses during celebrations at the [[Stade du 5 Juillet]] in [[Algiers]] following [[MC Alger]]’s league title win against [[NC Magra]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3en3nzlxxxo (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 NBA Finals]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] win the [[NBA Finals]] in [[List of NBA game sevens|seven games]] against the [[Indiana Pacers]], winning their first [[Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy|championship]] in [[History of the Oklahoma City Thunder|franchise history]]. [[Shai Gilgeous-Alexander]] is named [[NBA Finals Most Valuable Player|NBA Finals MVP]].
